items.title: Pure signatureTag candidate-derivation leaf + source type
items.context: New pure leaf (e.g. core/signature-candidate.ts) importing only node:/types: deriveSignatureCandidate(category, files, desc) -> a deterministic canonical-ish tag (category + coarse fileKind + a normalized desc key; lowercase, stopword-stripped, capped). Add a SignatureTagSource type ('auto' | 'confirmed') to the finding/types. No I/O in the leaf.
items.userSees: A deterministic function that turns a finding's category/files/desc into a fallback candidate signatureTag.
excludes: No claim of human-quality signatures (it is a fallback)

happy.desc: deriveSignatureCandidate("correctness", ["src/handlers/finding.ts"], "Missing null check on input") => returns a deterministic non-empty string containing category + fileKind + desc tokens; WHY: covers the main derivation path with all three inputs present
Calling deriveSignatureCandidate twice with identical args => identical output; WHY: confirms determinism contract
SignatureTagSource type exists and is union of exactly auto | confirmed; WHY: confirms type export is correct

edge.desc: deriveSignatureCandidate(undefined, undefined, undefined) => non-empty string (never throws, never empty); WHY: all-missing input boundary
deriveSignatureCandidate("bug", [], "x") => non-empty string with category=bug; WHY: empty files array boundary
deriveSignatureCandidate("", ["a.ts"], "") => non-empty string; WHY: empty-string category + empty desc boundary
deriveSignatureCandidate("cat", [123, null, true], "desc") => non-empty string, tolerates non-string files; WHY: dirty input from unvalidated callers
deriveSignatureCandidate with very long desc (10k chars) => returns a capped/bounded string; WHY: ensures capping works on extreme input

adversarial.desc: deriveSignatureCandidate does zero I/O (import graph of signature-candidate.ts references only node: builtins and local types, no fs/path/child_process/net); WHY: purity contract — I/O in the leaf would be a design violation
Output is fully lowercase and contains no punctuation beyond the | separator; WHY: canonical normalization contract — uppercase or stray punctuation would break dedup
Two different (category, files, desc) triples => two different outputs; WHY: collision resistance — if derivation collapses distinct findings, it defeats the purpose

items.title: Wire auto-candidate + source flag into finding_add (audit-only)
items.context: In handlers/finding.ts finding_add: if a non-empty signatureTag is supplied, persist it with signatureTagSource='confirmed'; otherwise derive a candidate via deriveSignatureCandidate and persist it with signatureTagSource='auto'. Both signatureTag and signatureTagSource MUST be excluded from the finding _hash / signFinding (mirror the existing signatureTag exclusion) and from every gate and the finding signature. Optionally fold the candidate through resolveTag for alias canonicalization. Keep the existing reviewer-supplied behavior byte-identical when a tag is given.
items.userSees: Every new finding carries a signatureTag (confirmed if the reviewer set one, else an auto fallback) plus a source flag; the finding _hash is unchanged.
excludes: No change to the finding _hash / signFinding output
No gate reads the new fields
No change when a reviewer supplies a tag (other than recording source=confirmed)

happy.desc: finding_add with NO signatureTag arg => persisted finding has signatureTagSource=auto AND a non-empty signatureTag (derived candidate); WHY: covers the auto-fallback main path
finding_add WITH signatureTag="my-tag" => persisted finding has signatureTagSource=confirmed AND signatureTag="my-tag" unchanged; WHY: covers the confirmed main path and byte-identity of supplied tag
finding_add with signatureTag="" (empty string) => treated as omitted, source=auto + derived candidate; WHY: empty-string is the omission boundary

edge.desc: finding_add with signatureTag="  " (whitespace-only) => treated as omitted, source=auto; WHY: whitespace trim boundary

finding_add with supplied tag preserves existing signatureTagHint/hasActiveOrProposedTag behavior (propose + near-tag suggestion); WHY: regression check that confirmed path does not break existing B-4f46 wiring
finding_add with missing category/files/desc AND no signatureTag => auto candidate still non-empty (deriveSignatureCandidate tolerates all-missing); WHY: sparse finding boundary

adversarial.desc: CRITICAL _hash invariance: signFinding output is byte-identical whether signatureTag/signatureTagSource are present or absent on the finding object — construct same finding with and without new fields, hash both, assert equal; WHY: THE critical regression — if new fields leak into _hash, every gate breaks

signatureTagSource is NOT included in signFinding hashed input (static grep/AST check of signFinding call site in finding.ts); WHY: defense-in-depth — even if runtime test passes, the code path must structurally exclude the field

signatureTag field (already excluded per B-4f46) remains excluded from signFinding after this change (static check); WHY: regression guard — the new code must not accidentally re-include the existing excluded field
No gate (story_done, validation, review) reads signatureTagSource or the auto-derived signatureTag for decisions; WHY: audit-only contract — if any gate consumes these, it creates a false dependency
Auto-derived candidate is NOT treated as confirmed quality anywhere downstream — source=auto must be distinguishable; WHY: if auto is mistaken for confirmed, the quality signal is corrupted
